name: Westfield Century City
address: 10250 Santa Monica Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90067
description:
Westfield Century City represents the pinnacle of luxury retail in Los Angeles, showcasing what modern, high-end shopping malls can achieve. Following a transformative $1 billion renovation completed in 2017, this 1.3 million square foot property emerged as one of the most prestigious shopping destinations on the West Coast, featuring an expertly curated collection of over 200 luxury brands and dining establishments.

The center blends indoor luxury retail with outdoor plazas, gardens, and open-air shopping environments. The three-level Nordstrom, renovated Bloomingdale's, and dedicated Macy's are joined by an unrivaled selection of high-end boutiques, including luxury flagship stores that are rare outside Manhattan or exclusive European destinations.

Westfield Century City proudly hosts the West Coast's first Eataly—a landmark Italian marketplace and restaurant—alongside celebrated dining venues like Din Tai Fung, Javier's, and many more, transforming the mall into a true culinary destination. Premium wellness offerings such as Equinox add to the elevated experience.

Modern sculptures, water features, and beautifully landscaped gardens create an exclusive resort-like atmosphere that distinguishes the property from traditional malls. Westfield Century City consistently draws affluent Los Angeles residents, international travelers, and celebrities seeking a premium, curated retail experience.

A commitment to experiential retail—combining luxury shopping, exceptional dining, wellness, and refined design—reflects the future of high-end malls and ensures Westfield Century City remains unmatched for those seeking luxury shopping in Los Angeles.
